title: Maya Civilization (c. 2000 BCE-1500 CE)
key_facts: Advanced Mesoamerican civilization with writing, mathematics, and astronomy
City-states with monumental architecture: pyramids, palaces, ballcourts
Complex calendar system more accurate than European calendars
Mysterious collapse around 900 CE, leaving cities abandoned
causes: Agricultural surplus supporting specialized labor and elite class
Trade networks connecting highlands and lowlands for resources
Religious and political organization supporting large-scale construction
Environmental pressures and possible climate change affecting agriculture
outcome: Classical period collapse and abandonment of major cities
Survival of Maya peoples in smaller communities
Preservation of cultural knowledge despite Spanish conquest
Integration into Spanish colonial system with some autonomy
impacts: Developed concept of zero and advanced mathematics
Created accurate astronomical observations and calendars
Influenced later Mesoamerican cultures including Aztecs
Left monumental architecture still studied today
